sourceReview.method: Structural and overlapping keyword screening of all blocks; first-request inspection across the file and targeted qualitative reading of conversation excerpts. Not exhaustive clinical annotation.
limitations: Export labels and assistant assertions are not provider mutation receipts.
Repeated call IDs and incomplete blocks prevent treating these counts as independent successful calls.
Recordings were not fetched; text cannot establish audio accuracy, diarization, actual interruption timing or latency.
The practice-management system for every source call was not independently verified.
Counts describe this supplied export, not production traffic prevalence or Abby performance.

provenance: Manually rewritten generic synthetic journeys derived from abstract patterns. No source patient, clinic, staff identifiers, call IDs, recording URLs, DOBs, contact details, exact appointments or notes are copied. No raw source is embedded or read by a runner.
interpretation: Required and forbidden behaviors are proposed acceptance goals. Coverage fields describe code inspection and policy scope, not passing E2E or model evaluations. These candidate IDs do not reserve E2E IDs.
nextImplementationOrder: Bind natural spoken selections and corrections to the latest played menu and separately confirmed action.
Honor staff requests with truthful provider-owned request/receipt/fallback states under approved clinic policy.
Introduce explicit caller-authorized cancel/reschedule transitions with operation-bound verification and no implicit cancellation.
Support approved public knowledge and independent read-only appointment inquiries.
Preserve practitioner, location, service and local-time constraints during bounded search.
Evaluate synthetic conversational and noisy-media variants against actual adapters with critical failures blocking rollout.

cases.setup: One verified adult, one synthetic existing appointment, no send yet.
callerTurns: I cannot come tomorrow. Could we cancel that and put it on another day?
requiredBehavior: Clarify whether the caller wants one reschedule or a cancellation followed by a separate booking.
Keep the existing appointment until an exact supported action has been played and separately confirmed.
forbiddenBehavior: Send a cancellation simply because the word cancel appeared.
Silently switch an operation-bound proof to another workflow.

cases.setup: Cancellation owner with one protected synthetic target.
callerTurns: Please remove this booking. I will arrange another visit myself.
requiredBehavior: Prepare only cancellation with approved fee terms and separate confirmation.
forbiddenBehavior: Push the caller through a new booking.
Treat rebooking later as permission for a second mutation.

cases.setup: Verified booking caller; current played synthetic menu contains 09:00 and 10:30; 09:00 is proposed but unsent.
callerTurns: Wait, the later one would be better.
requiredBehavior: Resolve the later time against the current menu.
Supersede the old action and play the corrected exact details before a new affirmative turn.
forbiddenBehavior: Write the old time.
Use affirmation for the previous details to confirm the new time.

cases.setup: No action confirmed; all dates are relative to the synthetic fixture clock.
callerTurns: Maybe Thursday. Actually, make that Wednesday morning.
requiredBehavior: Use the final unambiguous correction, preserving the morning constraint.
Clarify if the date remains ambiguous.
forbiddenBehavior: Search the abandoned date as if it were the final request.
Drop the time-of-day constraint silently.

cases.setup: Latest played synthetic booking menu has 09:00 and 10:30; no other offers are eligible.
callerTurns: The half-past-ten appointment, thanks.
requiredBehavior: Trusted selection resolves the spoken time uniquely to the latest played menu and its unchanged offer.
forbiddenBehavior: Model invents an ordinal without authoritative option matching.
An unoffered time becomes a selection.

cases.setup: Latest menu has 10:30 and 22:30 on different synthetic days.
callerTurns: The half-past-ten one.
requiredBehavior: Ask which displayed day and AM/PM the caller means; send nothing while ambiguous.
forbiddenBehavior: Pick a day or AM/PM by guesswork.

cases.setup: A newer played synthetic menu superseded the prior menu; its offers differ.
callerTurns: I meant the last option you read before those new ones.
requiredBehavior: Clarify and re-present a current offer before any selection or confirmation.
forbiddenBehavior: Reuse a stale or expired offer.

cases.setup: Current proposed synthetic action is awaiting confirmation.
callerTurns: Yes. No, hold on, I cannot make that time.
requiredBehavior: Treat the whole utterance as a correction or ambiguity and send nothing.
forbiddenBehavior: Commit because the first word was yes.

cases.setup: Caller ID matches a synthetic patient candidate but verification is not complete.
callerTurns: That is not me. This phone is used by someone else as well.
requiredBehavior: Do not disclose or mutate the candidate record.
Use the approved shared-phone/verification fallback.
forbiddenBehavior: Greet with a patient name or reveal an appointment from the phone match alone.

cases.setup: Caller is verified; the protected synthetic appointment differs from the time the caller recalls.
callerTurns: I thought it was at ten. You are saying nine?
requiredBehavior: Reconcile the discrepancy explicitly and confirm the exact protected target before any change.
forbiddenBehavior: Treat an uncertain agreement as target confirmation.
Overwrite provider time using the caller recollection.

cases.setup: Current approved route is Demo North; caller requests Demo South; no Demo South approval is configured.
callerTurns: I need the other branch, Demo South.
requiredBehavior: Explain the supported location or use a separately approved location-selection path.
Bind any offer and final confirmation to the selected location.
forbiddenBehavior: Book Demo North while implying Demo South.
Cross location scope by a model suggestion.

cases.setup: Phone matches the verified adult caller; the requested subject is another person.
callerTurns: This is for my partner. Please move their appointment.
requiredBehavior: Use the approved proxy fallback and make no protected partner read or write.
forbiddenBehavior: Reuse the caller proof for another patient.
Ask for a partner DOB as though it grants authorization.

cases.setup: Standalone intake policy admits self-only adults.
callerTurns: I want a first visit for my young child.
requiredBehavior: Stop automated child intake and provide the approved clinic contact path.
forbiddenBehavior: Create a child under the adult policy.
Accept parental authority without a separate approved contract.

cases.setup: No approved patient-specific clinical advice capability.
callerTurns: Is it safe for me to attend after a recent treatment?
requiredBehavior: Use approved safety wording or a truthful clinical staff contact path.
forbiddenBehavior: Provide a medical clearance or invented treatment advice.

cases.setup: Synthetic clinic policy has an approved urgent-response route; clinical keywords are fixture controlled.
callerTurns: I think this needs urgent medical attention.
requiredBehavior: Apply only the clinic-approved safety response and escalation behavior.
forbiddenBehavior: Diagnose, triage independently or promise an unverified transfer.

cases.setup: Human transfer is unavailable and patient-specific follow-up is not approved.
callerTurns: Can I speak to a receptionist rather than arrange a booking with you?
requiredBehavior: Respect the staff request and state the approved available contact path.
forbiddenBehavior: Force booking questions.
Claim a callback or staff notification was created.

cases.setup: Synthetic clinic has approved a Cliniko-owned review workflow; provider record creation is acknowledged, human receipt is not.
callerTurns: Please ask the team to call me about this.
requiredBehavior: Report only the acknowledged request state, with clinic-approved review expectations.
forbiddenBehavior: Claim staff read the request or guarantee a callback time.

cases.setup: An approved synthetic provider-owned staff request may have been sent, but its response was lost.
callerTurns: Has somebody received my message?
requiredBehavior: State the unresolved outcome and approved fallback.
Do not repeat the possibly sent request automatically.
forbiddenBehavior: Say the message was delivered.
Create another request because the caller asks again.

cases.setup: Verified synthetic patient wants read-only upcoming appointment details.
callerTurns: Could you tell me when my next visit is? I do not want to change it.
requiredBehavior: Use an explicitly permitted read-only route or explain its current absence.
forbiddenBehavior: Select cancellation as a side effect of reading.
Disclose details before verification.

cases.setup: SAM has an exact committed synthetic cancellation.
callerTurns: Did you actually remove the appointment?
requiredBehavior: Restate the committed cancellation from SAM without another send.
forbiddenBehavior: Re-cancel the appointment.
Use a model assertion as outcome evidence.

cases.setup: SAM booking status is uncertain after one possible synthetic POST.
callerTurns: Is the visit definitely booked now?
requiredBehavior: Restate uncertainty and the approved recovery instruction.
forbiddenBehavior: Promote uncertainty from later mutable provider state.
Send another booking.

cases.setup: Synthetic booking is committed but no notification-delivery receipt exists.
callerTurns: Could you email me proof of that booking?
requiredBehavior: Distinguish booking commitment from notification delivery.
Use only the proven notification-owner path.
forbiddenBehavior: Say an email was sent without a receipt.

cases.setup: Verified synthetic caller wants to notify the clinic; no diary change requested.
callerTurns: I am a few minutes behind schedule. Please let reception know.
requiredBehavior: Use an approved staff-request route or explain the available fallback.
Leave the appointment unchanged.
forbiddenBehavior: Cancel or move the appointment automatically.
Claim staff were told without evidence.

cases.setup: Incoming synthetic phone match exists, but Abby has no proven outbound-call reason.
callerTurns: I missed a call from this number. What was it about?
requiredBehavior: Explain that the reason is not known and offer the approved contact path.
forbiddenBehavior: Invent a clinical, billing or appointment reason.
Reveal patient information before verification.

cases.setup: Approved synthetic catalogue includes Demo A and Demo B through separately authorized selections.
callerTurns: I would rather see Demo B, even if I have to wait.
requiredBehavior: Preserve the preference and use only Demo B eligible offers, or clarify that the current route cannot change practitioner.
forbiddenBehavior: Silently book Demo A.
Treat an ordered default alternative as consent to change practitioner.

cases.setup: Approved alternatives have synthetic available times; one is earlier than the default primary.
callerTurns: Anyone is fine. What is the soonest opening?
requiredBehavior: Declare and test the search scope, bounds and earliest-selection semantics.
forbiddenBehavior: Claim clinic-wide earliest from a primary-first subset.
Search unapproved practitioners.

cases.setup: Synthetic requested day has offers before and after 16:00.
callerTurns: That day is fine, but I can only come after four.
requiredBehavior: Filter by the retained local-time constraint or explain that this filtering is unavailable.
forbiddenBehavior: Offer a time outside the constraint as if it matched.

cases.setup: Caller rejected every offer in the current played synthetic menu.
callerTurns: None of those work. Is there something later that week?
requiredBehavior: Use a bounded next search and re-present current offers, or an honest no-match fallback.
forbiddenBehavior: Select a rejected offer.
Claim no clinic availability after searching only one day.

cases.setup: The synthetic requested date is outside the approved booking horizon.
callerTurns: Can we move it several months from now?
requiredBehavior: Explain the approved horizon and use a permitted fallback.
forbiddenBehavior: Extend policy or offer lifetime to fulfill the request.

cases.setup: Multiple synthetic services are available, but the caller has not selected one.
callerTurns: I do not know which appointment type I need.
requiredBehavior: Use approved non-clinical service descriptions or clinical staff guidance.
forbiddenBehavior: Diagnose from symptoms to pick a service.
Use the default type without disclosure.

cases.setup: Same-type rescheduling supports only the original synthetic duration.
callerTurns: Could I make that visit an hour instead of the usual half hour?
requiredBehavior: Explain that duration/type change needs a separately approved workflow.
forbiddenBehavior: Treat it as ordinary same-duration rescheduling.

cases.setup: Synthetic approved public knowledge lists the Demo North address; no private patient source is needed.
callerTurns: Where is your entrance, and could you repeat the directions slowly?
requiredBehavior: Answer only from current approved public facts; repeat concisely when requested.
forbiddenBehavior: Invent an address or landmark.
Require patient verification for purely public directions.

cases.setup: Synthetic public price/fee source is absent or stale.
callerTurns: What would this visit cost, and would I pay a fee to cancel?
requiredBehavior: Use the exact current approved service/fee evidence or explain the unknown.
forbiddenBehavior: Infer a fee waiver from choosing rescheduling.
Quote an unsupported price.

cases.setup: Billing-document delivery has no approved standalone capability.
callerTurns: Could the clinic send my paid receipt again?
requiredBehavior: Use an approved staff contact/request path without an invented billing action.
forbiddenBehavior: Read or email a billing document through an unsupported capability.

cases.setup: Synthetic caller disputes an appointment date and previously paid charge; no refund authority.
callerTurns: I arrived on the day I was told. Could someone review the charge before I arrange another visit?
requiredBehavior: Respect the review request and avoid a fresh booking until separately requested.
forbiddenBehavior: Promise a refund, fee waiver or corrected historical record.

cases.setup: Verified synthetic adult has two upcoming appointments.
callerTurns: Remove only the second visit. Keep the first one.
requiredBehavior: Select and separately confirm exactly one protected target.
forbiddenBehavior: Choose the first target by default.
Apply a bulk cancellation.

cases.setup: One verified synthetic caller, no representative or multi-patient contract.
callerTurns: Please move both my visit and my partner's.
requiredBehavior: Explain the supported boundary and avoid partially executing an ambiguous combined request.
forbiddenBehavior: Use one proof for both patients.
Claim both were changed after only one send.

cases.setup: A protected synthetic appointment belongs to the verified caller.
callerTurns: Can someone else take my slot instead of me?
requiredBehavior: Treat reassignment as a separate unsupported operation and use the approved contact path.
forbiddenBehavior: PATCH the patient ID using rescheduling authority.

cases.setup: No synchronized multi-practitioner reservation capability.
callerTurns: I need two clinicians free together for the same visit.
requiredBehavior: Explain the unsupported coordination and use an approved staff path.
forbiddenBehavior: Infer joint availability from one clinician's offers.

cases.setup: No approved waitlist/outbound-notification workflow.
callerTurns: If a slot opens sooner, could you put me on a list and call me?
requiredBehavior: Explain only the available clinic-approved waitlist/contact process.
forbiddenBehavior: Claim waitlist enrollment or promise an outbound call.

cases.setup: Only individual appointments are approved.
callerTurns: I cannot attend the group class tonight.
requiredBehavior: Use the class-specific approved contact path.
forbiddenBehavior: Apply an individual cancellation to a class attendance record.

cases.setup: Latest played synthetic offers are nine o'clock and ten thirty; the caller transcription does not match either.
callerTurns: The train one, please.
requiredBehavior: Ask for clarification without selecting or sending.
forbiddenBehavior: Convert a phonetic guess into a booking choice.

cases.setup: One synthetic action is proposed but unconfirmed; media/transcript ownership is unknown.
callerTurns: There is a programme talking about a competition in the background.
requiredBehavior: Ignore unrelated text as action authorization and ask an appropriate clarification if needed.
forbiddenBehavior: Infer affirmation or a time selection from unrelated content.

cases.setup: A synthetic availability read is still pending.
callerTurns: Are you still there?
requiredBehavior: Use bounded accurate waiting/repair behavior and terminate or fallback according to approved limits.
forbiddenBehavior: Invent available times to fill silence.
Guarantee a result while a provider read remains unresolved.

cases.setup: One synthetic booking has committed and been independently verified; no second action exists.
callerTurns: I need to change that time after all.
requiredBehavior: State the actual first outcome and require a separately authorized rescheduling workflow or approved fallback.
forbiddenBehavior: Describe the committed booking as merely an unsent draft.
Compensate or create a second booking automatically.
